title: Accelerating voltage
description: Essential Criteria: Must state or derive U = mv²/(2q) using energy conservation or work-energy theorem.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Must state or derive E = vB from force balance in the velocity selector.

title: Electric field direction
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly determine the electric field direction (downward) using right-hand rule or force analysis for a positive charge.

title: Kinetic energy expression
description: Essential Criteria: Must derive or state Ek = ½(2m)v² + qBvd or equivalent, accounting for both initial kinetic energy and work done by magnetic force.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important Criteria: Must apply work-energy theorem correctly to the second particle's trajectory through the velocity selector.

title: Mass substitution
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly substitute mass 2m into kinetic energy term while keeping charge q unchanged.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if work done by magnetic force has wrong sign (magnetic force does no work, but electric force from induced field does).

title: Direction confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if electric field direction is stated as upward or if force directions are reversed.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Check that final expressions have consistent units or include proper units in answers.
